page_title: GEN 0-0 PAR | Genoa v Parma 19/10/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' That's the end of the match.
90+7' Genoa take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
90+7' Maxwel Cornet (Genoa) failed to beat the goalkeeper from the penalty spot.
90+7' Maxwel Cornet (Genoa) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
90+5' Mariano Troilo (Parma) is given a yellow card.

90+5' Mariano Troilo (Parma) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee immediately stops play. PENALTY! One of the players from Genoa is about to take a penalty kick. Let's see how this ends.
90+4' Lorenzo Colombo (Genoa) serves up a nice cross, but Zion Suzuki punches the ball away.
90+3' The Genoa players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
87' Carlos Cuesta has decided to make a change. Milan Djuric (Parma) replaces Mateo Pellegrino.
87' Nahuel Estevez (Parma) is not able to continue due to his injury and will be replaced by Mariano Troilo.
84' Brooke Norton-Cuffy (Genoa) is penalised for holding. Simone Sozza signals a set piece.
82' A brilliant cross into the box finds Jeff Ekhator (Genoa), who directs his header to the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper shows his reflexes and makes an astonishing save.
81' Patrick Vieira prepares a substitution. Ruslan Malinovskyi is replaced by Maxwel Cornet (Genoa).
79' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Oliver Sorensen (Parma) replaces Patrick Cutrone.
78' The resulting set piece from Genoa is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
76' Lorenzo Venturino (Genoa) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.

74' What a poor attempt! Ruslan Malinovskyi (Genoa) drives another shot towards goal - this time from further out, but it couldn't have been worse if he had shot blindfolded. The ball goes into the stands. The ball goes out of play and Parma will have a goal kick.
73' Mateo Pellegrino (Parma) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Simone Sozza saw the whole situation.
73' Mikael Egill Ellertsson (Genoa) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross.
70' Lorenzo Colombo (Genoa) violates the rules and gets a yellow card.
70' Lorenzo Colombo (Genoa) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Simone Sozza blows his whistle for an infringement.
69' A pass by Mandela Keita (Parma) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
68' Mikael Egill Ellertsson (Genoa) struck the ball which rebounded to the edge of the box. His attempt went narrowly over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Parma.
68' Genoa seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
66' Substitution. Jeff Ekhator (Genoa) in, Caleb Ekuban out.
66' Patrick Vieira decides to make a substitution. Morten Frendrup will be replaced by Lorenzo Colombo (Genoa).
63' Patrizio Masini (Genoa) is unlucky with a low drive from the edge of the box. A decent save by Zion Suzuki stops the ball from hitting the middle of the net.
61' Nahuel Estevez (Parma) picked up a yellow card from referee.
58' Vitinha comes off the pitch to be replaced by Lorenzo Venturino (Genoa).
56' Brooke Norton-Cuffy (Genoa) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone. It's a throw-in for Parma.
53' Neat passing move from Genoa in order to create new attacking opportunities.
48' Ruslan Malinovskyi (Genoa) produces a good strike that sails to the middle of the goal, but his low effort ends up in the goalkeeper's gloves.
46' Half-time substitution. Pontus Almqvist (Parma) will not participate anymore and Christian Ordonez is coming on.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Patrick Vieira probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Stefano Sabelli. He is replaced by Valentin Carboni (Genoa).
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+2' The end of the first half.

45+1' Johan Vasquez (Genoa) tries to score from mid-range after collecting a rebound, but his shot lacks accuracy and sails high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Parma will have a goal kick.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
45' It's a yellow card for Sascha Britschgi (Parma).
43' Substitution. Lautaro Valenti (Parma) on for Adrian Bernabe Garcia.
42' The rules are clear, two yellow cards are followed by a red. Abdoulaye Ndiaye (Parma) must hit the showers early today.
42' Simone Sozza blows the whistle, Abdoulaye Ndiaye (Parma) is penalised for a foul. A free kick to Genoa.

41' Pontus Almqvist (Parma) brings his opponent down. Simone Sozza has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. Genoa win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
37' Abdoulaye Ndiaye (Parma) is yellow-carded.

37' Abdoulaye Ndiaye (Parma) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Simone Sozza blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
36' Poor challenge! Johan Vasquez (Genoa) is penalised for tripping and Simone Sozza blows his whistle.
33' Ruslan Malinovskyi (Genoa) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
32' Genoa control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
29' Ruslan Malinovskyi (Genoa) gets booked for the first time in this match.
29' Simone Sozza blows his whistle for a foul after Ruslan Malinovskyi (Genoa) hacks down one of his opponents.
28' Ruslan Malinovskyi (Genoa) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.

28' Zion Suzuki makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded towards the bottom right corner by Vitinha (Genoa) after a cross from the side. Genoa force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
27' Abdoulaye Ndiaye (Parma) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
26' Abdoulaye Ndiaye (Parma) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
25' Pontus Almqvist (Parma) makes a rough challenge and Simone Sozza blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Genoa in a dangerous position.
23' The Genoa players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
21' Vitinha (Genoa) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Parma.
20' Johan Vasquez (Genoa) sends a long ball in, but Zion Suzuki comfortably gathers the ball.

17' A short pass finds Caleb Ekuban (Genoa). He spots the keeper off his line and shoots from mid-range, but the ball sails high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Parma.
16' Vitinha (Genoa) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
15' Caleb Ekuban (Genoa) commits a foul after bringing down his opponent with a slide tackle. A free kick is awarded to Parma.
12' Simone Sozza interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Vitinha (Genoa).
10' Ruslan Malinovskyi (Genoa) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.

9' Patrick Cutrone (Parma) finds some space on the edge of the box after some nice individual play and curls a shot in on goal, but the ball flies just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Genoa will have a goal kick.
6' The Parma players are exchanging some short passes.

6' Caleb Ekuban (Genoa) decides to take on the shot from mid-range after a rebound, but he fails to connect properly with the ball and the effort sails harmlessly wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Parma.
4' Brooke Norton-Cuffy (Genoa) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
1' Alessandro Circati (Parma) knocks his opponent down with an over-the-top tackle. Genoa will take a free kick.
1' The first half has started.
Parma will kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Simone Sozza.
